# Awful.chat

> End-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer chat with voice, video, and file sharing.
> Open source. No accounts, no phone numbers, no personal data required.

Awful.chat is a privacy-focused web chat app (PWA). Identity is a BIP39
mnemonic held on the user's device (ed25519, did:key). Text messages and
files travel peer-to-peer over libp2p (WebRTC with a circuit-relay
fallback); the relay server introduces peers, forwards encrypted traffic,
and holds a 48-hour encrypted mailbox for offline DMs - it cannot read any
of it. Voice calls are fully peer-to-peer. Group video and
screen share are routed through a mediasoup SFU. Files transfer via
WebTorrent between peers.

Key properties:
- No sign-up: create an identity locally, back it up with 12 words
- End-to-end encrypted messaging (noise protocol between peers)
- Signed messages (ed25519) to prevent impersonation
- Delivery and read receipts for direct messages
- Offline DMs: an encrypted 48-hour relay mailbox (sealed to the recipient,
  padded sizes) delivers direct messages without both peers being online;
  on by default, can be turned off in settings
- Push notifications that carry no content: the relay wakes a closed phone
  with "you have mail", the app collects and decrypts locally; on by
  default, off in settings
- Installable as a PWA on phones and desktops, with native picture-in-picture
  for calls and screen shares
- Instance plugins: watch-together, polls, and more, bundled at build time
  and compiled into the app, so they are part of what a build hash covers
- Device sync via QR code between your own devices; encrypted backup files
  for restoring elsewhere
- Verifiable builds: every instance publishes the commit it runs, and
  awful-verify (https://github.com/awful-org/awful-verify) checks that the
  served code matches the published source
- No analytics, no trackers, no third-party scripts beyond an optional
  YouTube embed inside the watch-together plugin
- Self-hostable: Docker Compose with a Go relay, mediasoup SFU, coturn

## Links

- [App](https://awful.chat/app): the chat application (requires JavaScript)
- [Source code](https://github.com/awful-org/awful.chat): open source, self-hosting instructions in the README
- [Protocol and storage spec](https://github.com/awful-org/awful.chat/blob/main/docs/spec.md): how identity, messages, the mailbox and at-rest encryption work
- [Plugins](https://github.com/awful-org/awful.chat/blob/main/frontend/plugins/README.md): writing and installing plugins
- [Curated plugins](https://github.com/awful-org/awfully-awesome)
